Sneha Chatterjee | sneha.chatterjee301@example.com | +91 9197480333
Thane West

Professional Summary
Results-driven Business Development professional with experience in driving B2B Sales, managing client relationships, and leveraging Salesforce to streamline pipelines and improve conversion rates. Strong collaborator with cross-functional teams and experience documenting processes in Confluence. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
B2B Sales, Salesforce, Confluence

Work Experience

Business Development Manager, NimbusSoft (Mar 2026 - Present)
- Managed targeted B2B Sales campaigns to enterprise prospects, using Salesforce to track lead progression and prioritize high-value accounts for outreach.
- Negotiated and closed pilot contracts with three mid-market clients, documenting deal terms and onboarding steps in Confluence to accelerate time-to-value.
- Collaborated with product and implementation teams to define success metrics for pilots and updated Salesforce opportunity stages to reflect standardized forecasting.

Business Development Manager, Bluefin Logistics (Jan 2026 - Feb 2026)
- Executed focused B2B Sales initiatives for logistics service offerings, qualifying leads and updating Salesforce to provide accurate weekly pipeline reports.
- Secured two strategic proofs-of-concept with regional partners and captured scope and timelines in Confluence for handoff to operations.
- Coordinated cross-functional meetings to resolve commercial and operational blockers, ensuring smooth transition from sales to delivery tracked in Salesforce.

Account Executive, Meesho (Oct 2022 - Dec 2025)
- Drove B2B Sales for merchant acquisition and growth programs, maintaining detailed account records and activity logs in Salesforce to improve follow-up cadence.
- Increased average deal size through value-based selling, documenting playbooks and best practices in Confluence for the broader sales team.
- Managed renewal and upsell discussions with existing accounts, leveraging Salesforce analytics to identify expansion opportunities and prioritize outreach.

Education
MCA, Symbiosis
